title.narrative: Reformas a la Atencin Primaria en Salud

description.narrative: THE PROGRAM IS DIRECTED TO EXPANDING THE COVERAGE AND IMPROVING THE QUALITY OF HEALTH SERVICES AT THE PRIMARY LEVEL, WITH EMPHASIS ON MOTHER-INFANTS. IT'S OBJECTIVE IS TO INTRODUCE INCENTIVES TO THE DELIVERY AND USE OF MOST COST-EFFECTIVE INTERVENTIONS, AND TO OBTAIN A MORE EFFICIENT ALLOCATION OF RESOURCES. THIS PROGRAM IS INSERTED IN THE PROCESS OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE DESCENTRALIZATION OF THE COUNTRY AND FOCUS ON FIVE DEPARTMENTS.
